preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c_i <= 10**9 for c_i in c)
preconditions.description: Each vertex price c_i must be a non-negative integer not exceeding 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: The number of edges must be n-1, and each edge must connect valid vertices.

postconditions.description: The first output value must be the minimum cost s Arkady has to pay.
The second output value must be the number of vertices k in at least one optimal set.

postconditions.expression: len(vertices) == k and all(1 <= v <= n for v in vertices)
postconditions.description: The output must contain k distinct vertex indices in increasing order.
